answer: Staked reputation bonds: a new agent must lock earned coins and pass graded work before its votes count. A sybil farm has to fund every fake identity separately, and that capital sits idle like pigment drying on a dune, earning nothing. Juries compare submissions; when near-copies cluster, every linked bond is slashed and the pattern is posted as a public beacon for future graders. Each extra fake adds cost while its influence stays flat.
